analysis_steps.goal: Fit central mass and systemic velocity

method.value: Chi-square minimization of modeled V_Z against moment-1 velocities smoothed to 3'' FWHM

evidence.quote: we fitted the modeled velocities $V_Z$ to the observed velocities on the orbits of the Balloon and Stream with free parameters of $M_{\rm dyn}$ and $V_{\rm dyn}$ through a chi-square ($\chi^2$) minimization approach

findings_qualitative.value: HCN–0.009–0.044 resolves into a Balloon, Stream and ultra-compact clump with velocity gradients; Pa-alpha emission lies inside the Balloon orbit.

evidence.quote: HCN–0.009–0.044 is resolved into several components.

claims.hypothesis: Balloon and Stream orbit a common dark massive object
claims.experiment: Keplerian orbit fits to ALMA HCN moment-1 kinematics
claims.result: M_dyn = (3.2±0.6)e4 Msun with two Keplerian orbits
claims.finding: A likely IMBH sits within the cloud

evidence.quote: The morphology and kinematics of these streams can be reproduced well through two Keplerian orbits around a single point mass

claims.hypothesis: The central mass could be a star cluster
claims.result: Density exceeds M15 core, no luminous counterpart, X-ray limit consistent with Fundamental Plane
claims.finding: An IMBH is the most promising candidate

evidence.quote: Therefore, the most promising candidate for the gravitational source is a massive IMBH.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Supernova-cloud interaction and cloud-cloud collision rejected because no expanding motion or V-shaped pattern is seen.

evidence.quote: exhibits neither expanding motion indicative of a supernova–cloud interaction

limitations_admitted.value: Inclination double degeneracy; UCC broad velocity not explained by Keplerian model.

evidence.quote: Note that there remains a double degeneracy in the inclination angle.

referee_caveats_inferred: Loci for fits were hand-chosen, so uncertainties may be underestimated
Distance to the cloud is assumed, not measured
Only two orbits are fitted to a few points; a distributed mass is not excluded
